_comment: DFS strategy presets (owner directive 2026-09-30, DFS-§6-03). A preset states its objective and the models it needs. validationState stays 'unsupported' until those models are built and validated; selecting one never silently runs the projection baseline. Dimensions compose (payout shape x entry restriction); they are not one enum.

presets.label: Head-to-head

objective.description: Maximize the probability of outscoring the specific opponent (ties per the contest's tie rule).

presets.unsupportedReason: Needs outcome_distribution, joint_correlation, opponent_lineup_or_field_model — none validated yet (roadmap P4/P5).
presets.baselineFallback: projection_baseline — available only by explicit choice, labelled not contest-evaluated.
presets.notes: Not 'minimum variance': the target is the opponent's score distribution.

objective.description: Maximize P(score ≥ the cash line), where the cash line is the paid-place boundary of the modelled field.

presets.unsupportedReason: Needs outcome_distribution, joint_correlation, field_model — none validated yet (roadmap P4/P5).
presets.baselineFallback: projection_baseline — available only by explicit choice, labelled not contest-evaluated.
presets.notes: Payout and tie treatment differ from double-up; kept separate.

presets.label: Double-up

objective.description: Maximize P(score ≥ the cash line) at the double-up paid share.

presets.unsupportedReason: Needs outcome_distribution, joint_correlation, field_model — none validated yet (roadmap P4/P5).
presets.baselineFallback: projection_baseline — available only by explicit choice, labelled not contest-evaluated.
presets.notes: Different paid share and prize from 50/50.

presets.label: Multiplier (3x/5x/10x)

objective.description: Maximize P(finishing inside the paid places) — a higher, narrower cash line.

presets.unsupportedReason: Needs outcome_distribution, joint_correlation, field_model — none validated yet (roadmap P4/P5).
presets.baselineFallback: projection_baseline — available only by explicit choice, labelled not contest-evaluated.
presets.notes: Rewards more upside than 50/50 because fewer places pay.

presets.label: Small-field GPP

objective.description: Maximize E[payout] − fee under this ladder, the modelled field and duplication.

presets.unsupportedReason: Needs outcome_distribution, joint_correlation, ownership_forecast, field_model, duplication_model — none validated yet (roadmap P4/P5).
presets.baselineFallback: projection_baseline — available only by explicit choice, labelled not contest-evaluated.
presets.notes: No universal ownership target or stack count is assumed.

presets.label: Large-field GPP

objective.description: Maximize E[payout] − fee; top-heavy ladders make duplication and joint outcomes decisive.

presets.unsupportedReason: Needs outcome_distribution, joint_correlation, ownership_forecast, field_model, duplication_model — none validated yet (roadmap P4/P5).
presets.baselineFallback: projection_baseline — available only by explicit choice, labelled not contest-evaluated.
presets.notes: Alternatives offered as explicit choices: P(top 1%), P(first), risk-constrained return.

presets.label: Single-entry

objective.description: One lineup evaluated alone against the field.

presets.unsupportedReason: Needs outcome_distribution, joint_correlation, ownership_forecast, field_model, duplication_model — none validated yet (roadmap P4/P5).
presets.baselineFallback: projection_baseline — available only by explicit choice, labelled not contest-evaluated.
presets.notes: Entry restriction is a dimension, not a contest type.

presets.label: 3-max

objective.description: Up to 3 entries evaluated jointly (own-entry ties and rank interactions included).

presets.unsupportedReason: Needs outcome_distribution, joint_correlation, ownership_forecast, field_model, duplication_model — none validated yet (roadmap P4/P5).
presets.baselineFallback: projection_baseline — available only by explicit choice, labelled not contest-evaluated.
presets.notes: Does not auto-fill every allowed slot.

presets.label: 20-max

objective.description: Up to 20 entries selected jointly from a candidate pool.

presets.unsupportedReason: Needs outcome_distribution, joint_correlation, ownership_forecast, field_model, duplication_model — none validated yet (roadmap P4/P5).
presets.baselineFallback: projection_baseline — available only by explicit choice, labelled not contest-evaluated.
presets.notes: Does not auto-fill every allowed slot.

presets.label: 150-max

objective.description: Up to 150 entries selected jointly; recommended count may be far below 150 or zero.

presets.unsupportedReason: Needs outcome_distribution, joint_correlation, ownership_forecast, field_model, duplication_model — none validated yet (roadmap P4/P5).
presets.baselineFallback: projection_baseline — available only by explicit choice, labelled not contest-evaluated.
presets.notes: Does not auto-fill every allowed slot.

presets.label: Single-game / Showdown

objective.description: Captain/MVP multiplier rules change scoring identity; needs its own rule set first.

presets.unsupportedReason: Needs outcome_distribution, joint_correlation, ownership_forecast, field_model, duplication_model, showdown_ruleset — none validated yet (roadmap P4/P5).
presets.baselineFallback: projection_baseline — available only by explicit choice, labelled not contest-evaluated.

presets.label: Medium-field GPP

objective.description: Maximize E[payout] − fee for a mid-sized field under the actual ladder and duplication.

presets.unsupportedReason: Needs outcome_distribution, joint_correlation, ownership_forecast, field_model, duplication_model — none validated yet (roadmap Phases D–F).
presets.baselineFallback: projection_baseline — available only by explicit choice, labelled not contest-evaluated.
presets.notes: Field size comes from the contest, not from this label.

presets.label: Satellite

objective.description: Maximize P(finishing inside the ticket-paying places); every qualifying place pays the same ticket.

presets.unsupportedReason: Needs outcome_distribution, joint_correlation, field_model — none validated yet (roadmap Phases D–F).
presets.baselineFallback: projection_baseline — available only by explicit choice, labelled not contest-evaluated.
presets.notes: Ticket value is the owner's stated value; a ticket is not cash.

presets.label: Qualifier

objective.description: Maximize P(qualifying) for the downstream event; the downstream event's value is separate evidence.

presets.unsupportedReason: Needs outcome_distribution, joint_correlation, field_model — none validated yet (roadmap Phases D–F).
presets.baselineFallback: projection_baseline — available only by explicit choice, labelled not contest-evaluated.

presets.label: Custom

objective.description: The owner picks the objective explicitly (e.g. P(cash), P(top 1%), E[payout], risk-constrained).

presets.unsupportedReason: Needs outcome_distribution — none validated yet (roadmap Phases D–F).
presets.baselineFallback: projection_baseline — available only by explicit choice, labelled not contest-evaluated.
